name: dang-55-shadowing
title: fix(dang): shadow imported types locally
head: d7b82e009e594336af9a0ace05ac67cc105a1b68
notes: The first commit of vito/dang#55 (fixes #52), reviewed alone: +396/-50 over 5 files. Ground truth from history: later commits in the same PR fixed each issue below, each adding a regression test or golden that fails at this head, so they are vetted real and, where a test reproduces them, confirmed. The fixing commits are cited in each summary; PR #55 merged with all of them (head dcc8f89).

issues.summary: inferInlineFragments resolves a fragment's type condition with modEnv.NamedType, the ambient environment, so once a local `type User` shadows the imported Test.User, `... on User` on a Test union or interface (search(...), node(id:)) picks the LOCAL User: fields that exist only on the local type (`origin`) are accepted in the fragment, and real Test.User fields (`age`) are rejected. Fixed by fdc3b6e0de (fix(dang): resolve fragments via receiver), which resolves the condition from the receiver's members/implementers and adds tests/test_inline_fragment_import_shadowing.dang plus two error goldens.

Local type names are only hoisted (Hoist pass 0) inside the types phase, which InferFormsWithPhases runs after the constants phase. So a constant annotated with a shadowed name and declared before the type, `pub maybe: User = null` above a local `type User`, binds to the imported Test.User, and `pub echoed: User = maybe` then fails as a mismatch between the imported and the local User: shadowing works or not depending on declaration order. Fixed by dcc8f89dfd (fix(dang): hoist local type names earlier), which adds a 'type names' phase right after imports, with tests/test_imported_type_shadowing_annotation.dang and an env_test assertion.

Now that a local type and an imported one can share a name, mismatch errors print both unqualified: the change's own golden shows `cannot use User! as User!`, `cannot use Status! as Status!`, `cannot use [SearchResult!]! as [SearchResult!]!`, which tell the user nothing. Fixed by 9dc903dfda (fix(dang): qualify imported type errors) and af13384818 (fix(dang): qualify type display paths), which render imported types as `Test.User!` and update the golden.

sound.summary: A local declaration that shadows an unqualified imported type gets a fresh module (declareLocalType) and the unqualified alias is cleared, instead of reusing and mutating the imported schema type, so a qualified reference to a shadowed name (Test.User after a local `type User`) still resolves to the imported type.
Type, enum, scalar, interface and union declarations all go through declareLocalType, and the new gqlserver tests cover shadowing for each kind.
